description: REQUIRES prior hometax__session__login call with same account_link_id. List the certificate templates that can be applied for (9). The slugs returned here are exactly the values accepted by cert_template; nothing else is.

account_link_id.description: Account link ID (UUID v4). Optional — the server auto-resolves from your API key when omitted. Provide explicitly only when you have multiple certificates for the same provider. Each institution has a separate ID (Hometax != NHIS != NPS != FourInsure).

name: hometax__certificate__list_templates
title: 증명서 템플릿 목록 조회
